mechanism: Nalmefene (opioid antagonist) may reduce the efficacy of bisacodyl's prokinetic effects and precipitate opioid withdrawal if used concurrently with opioid-containing regimens, while bisacodyl increases GI motility which could affect nalmefene absorption.
action: Monitor bowel function and opioid withdrawal symptoms; consider timing separation or alternative laxatives; assess indication for concurrent use.
